description: Rhythm Explorer CV Expander: adds three channels of stepped random CV for each of the eight divisions of a Rhythm Explorer, and goes immediately to its left or right

params.text: Sets the span its channel's outputs cover, 1V to 10V, and is ignored while that channel's RND input is patched
Sets the lowest voltage its channel's outputs reach, -10V to 10V, the highest being that plus the span; it is ignored while that channel's RND input is patched
Sets which side the parent Rhythm Explorer is on, yellow for left and orange for right; the corner lamp on that side glows yellow when the connection was made and red when it was not

inputs.text: Replaces the Rhythm Explorer's own random numbers for that channel. Eight polyphonic channels give each division its own voltage, a monophonic cable one for all, and the voltage is used unscaled

outputs.text: Steps to a new voltage each time its division fires, repeating in the same pattern the division gates do, and holding while that division is muted. Down the column follows the divisions left to right

notes: the outputs carry nothing until the module is adjacent to a Rhythm Explorer and the parent direction switch points at the side that module is on; the corner lamp there is then yellow
